messages:
emily: thinking out loud — we keep getting asks for per-route *and* per-model saved views in console analytics. current saved queries are basically global. can we sketch a simple UX for a route+model matrix that users can save and pin?
raj: +1, we need both dimension and scope. most folks want: route-only, model-only, or route+model. sometimes team-level too.
kevin: agree. pro tip: keep the save action low-friction. a tiny dropdown next to filters: `Save as...` with scope radio: [personal | team | org] and a toggle for pin to route header.
sara: question — how important is showing these saved views inline in the route inspector vs a central "Saved queries" list? users jump from route -> telemetry a lot.
emily: prefer inline for discoverability. quick mock: when you open a route, top-right has chips for 'Saved views' that filter the dashboard. also global saved queries page for management.
raj: telemetry implication: saved view should carry filter state + time window + model variant. we need deterministic telemetry keys so alerts/evals can reference them. e.g. `saved_query:v1|route:/api/generate|model:opt-8|tw:1h`
kevin: +1 for deterministic id. also allow URL params to encode saved query so links are shareable: `/routes/generate?view=sv_XXX`
sara: UX nit — users may want ephemeral filters (quick ad-hoc) vs persisted saved views. suggest a small dot on chip: solid = saved, hollow = ad-hoc.
emily: implementation constraints: avoid exploding saved query storage for every minor toggle. backend should store a compact representation, and frontend can hydrate.
prod-bot: deploy scheduled: console/filter-save-service v0.2 rolling to prod at 03:00 UTC.
raj: regarding permissions — team-scoped saved queries should be visible to team members and editable by creators + admins. we should mirror route ownership model.
kevin: open question: should saved queries be composable? e.g., base saved query + additional local filters. seems neat for power users.
sara: for MVP let's do: create/save, pin to route, share link, scope (personal/team/org), include model variant. composability can come later.
emily: agree. I'll mock a small flow and update the console figma. adding a sample JSON blob for backend storage:
```
{
  "id": "sv_7f9c",
  "name": "generate-opt8-1h",
  "scope": "team:ai-apps",
  "filters": ["route:/api/generate","model:opt-8","status:2xx"],
  "time_window": "1h",
  "pinned": true
}
```
kevin: looks good. also add `created_by` and `visibility` fields.
emily: will add. i'll push a quick figma and a short PR to the console that wires the dropdown to telemetry. thanks all :thumbsup:
prod-bot: note: analytics-event created `saved_query.created` by emily at 1793123560
kevin: follow-up: can we make saved queries hot keys? cmd+k -> list saved views for current route. small perf check: loading chips shouldn't hit heavy queries.
sara: final: prioritize router+model matrix and pin-to-route for next sprint. leaving comments on the figma file now.
